The '''Berd Fleet''' was a fleet of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] organized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that landed on [[Harix]] to rescue several schoolchildren from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

After arriving at Harix, the Berd Fleet split up its forces, and Luke deployed several drones to trick the Empire's forces into believing the attacking force was larger than it was. Meanwhile, the real fleet landed on the planet with little difficulty.
